newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Eight orphans die in Armenia fire.
newsitem.headline: Eight orphans die in Armenia fire.

text.p: Eight children died and four others suffered from toxic gases when a fire broke out in an orphanage for mentally and physically handicapped children in the Armenian capital Yerevan, officials said on Thursday.

A spokesman for the Social Security Ministry said the incident on Sunday night had been caused by a malfunction in an electric heating device. He could not say how old the children were or give any other details.
Armenia , involved in a long territorial dispute with neighbouring Azerbaijan, suffers huge energy shortages and residents of Yerevan use all means they can to get extra heat in winter.
